scenarios.prompt: Create first-note.txt containing exactly `alpha checkpoint` followed by one newline. Then create second-note.txt containing exactly `beta checkpoint` followed by one newline. Finally read both files, verify their exact bytes, and report their paths.
scenarios.setup: Use a clean writable Project directory with first-note.txt and second-note.txt absent.

scenarios.prompt: Inspect session-plan-status-sync-eval-fixtures/dataset-a.csv and dataset-b.csv concurrently when supported. For each file report row count and sum of value, then compare the sums after both inspections finish.
scenarios.setup: Copy the fixed fixture directory into the clean Project directory without modification.
expected_results: dataset-a.csv has 3 data rows and value sum 10
dataset-b.csv has 3 data rows and value sum 31

scenarios.prompt: Explore session-plan-status-sync-eval-fixtures/exploration, use its README.txt to identify the relevant CSV, then report that file's row count and signal sum. Do not use the distractor in the result.
scenarios.setup: Copy the fixed fixture directory into the clean Project directory without modification.
expected_results: relevant.csv has 2 rows and signal sum 10

scenarios.prompt: Start dependency-eligible checks of session-plan-status-sync-eval-fixtures/missing-input.txt and available-peer.txt. missing-input.txt is deliberately absent. Report the available peer's exact result, and do not start the combine step unless both checks succeed.
scenarios.setup: Copy the fixed fixture directory into the clean Project directory. Confirm available-peer.txt exists and missing-input.txt does not.

scenarios.prompt: Continue the explicitly selected Plan after the test harness interrupts the second step. Use the protected checkpoint before taking action; do not recreate durable-note.txt if it is already completed.
scenarios.setup: Create durable-note.txt with exact bytes `durable checkpoint\n`; record Complete durable note completed and Run interruptible check in_progress; interrupt the interaction; then explicitly continue the same Artifact Version and revision.
expected_results: the inherited in_progress check is verified before its terminal status is chosen

scenarios.prompt: Continue the explicitly selected Plan after the provider context is replaced. Use the protected checkpoint before taking action and synthesize the recorded values.
scenarios.setup: Record Record first result completed with value 10 and Record second result completed with value 31; replace or compact away the provider conversation context; then explicitly continue the same durable Plan.
expected_results: the two completed steps are not repeated
